idea-plugin.name: Database Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Database Development and Management Tool

This software solution extends the capabilities of IntelliJ IDEA and related products by providing a set of practical tools for database development and management. It includes a user-friendly SQL and PL/SQL editor that matches the IDE's standards, along with features for managing database connections, running scripts, viewing and editing database objects, and updating data and code. The tool also supports database compiler tasks, method execution, debugging, and the creation of database objects. Additionally, it offers integrated navigation features across all components, making it a reliable and efficient choice for database development and administration.

This product is developed and maintained by Oracle

Supported Databases:
  • Oracle
  • MySQL
  • SQLite
  • PostgreSQL
  • Any JDBC compliant database (EXPERIMENTAL)
